title: Softflip sequencer — scratchpad and sequencing plan
content:
Purpose and context:

Short version: experiment with a low-impact "softflip" strategy to migrate a small cohort from model-v11-opt to model-v12-q4 while preserving latency SLOs and avoiding accuracy regressions. This doc is my working notes — sequencing, safety checks, quick commands, and post-mortem hooks. Not a final playbook.

Why "softflip"?
- Need a mechanism to change live model variant for select cohorts without full pin or blunt traffic split.
- Aim to let SDK clients flip a routing tag (softflip token) so we can observe behavior with per-tenant visibility and fast back-out.
- Useful when capacity looks tight for an all-at-once flip but we want production samples.

Scope and constraints:
- Target cohorts: 5 internal customers + 2 sandbox tenants (total ~0.8% traffic).
- Duration: staged: 1h smoke -> 8h observe -> 24h extended -> decide (promote/retire).
- Only in region: us-west1 (avoid global blasts).
- Model variants: model-v11-opt (baseline) -> model-v12-q4 (candidate).
- No other infra changes during window (no infra deploys, scheduler tuning, or heavy cache purges).

Acceptance signals (pass/fail):
- Telemetry (primary):
  - p95_latency_ms (route=model-v12-q4) must be <= baseline_p95 * 1.25 over 1h window.
  - error_rate_5m (HTTP 5xx + 4xx-rate-sensitive) <= baseline + 0.1% absolute.
  - prompt_consistency_score (synthetic prompts) >= baseline - 0.02 (measured every 30m).
- Quality checks:
  - Sampling: 1000 responses across cohorts evaluated by eval-suite A (semantic similarity and hallucination heuristics).
  - Canonical prompts (n=20) must not regress on intent classification accuracy by >2%.
- Business signal guardrail: any customer-facing alert (Pager duty) triggers immediate pinback unless triaged by on-call SRE + Eng.

Staging checklist (pre-flip):
- [ ] Deploy v12 model to canary pool and validate warmup with synthetic traffic (10k tokens) — tag: warmup-v12-2024-09-28.
- [ ] Validate KV cache compatibility and cold-start latency (script: infra/tools/kv-check.sh).
- [ ] Run offline eval suite on a 1k-sample from recent customer prompts (eval job: GH Actions -> infra/evals/softflip/run).
- [ ] Prepare rollout toggle in console and SDK: feature flag softflip.model_v12.enabled (default off).
- [ ] Create dedicated dashboard (dash id: dash-ff-2024-09-28) with p95/p50, errors, token-rate, payload-size, and prompt_consistency_score.
- [ ] Notify CS owners of the 5 tenants, include rollback contact and quiet hours block.

Sequencer steps (live) — shorthand commands and notes:
1) Smoke flip (1% of target cohort traffic):
   - Console: enable softflip for tenant tags t-aaa,t-bbb (UI -> Routing -> Softflip -> +tenants)
   - CLI (backup): rctl rollout softflip enable --tenants t-aaa,t-bbb --model model-v12-q4 --region us-west1 --fraction 0.01
   - Observe for 10m, then check dash p95 and errors.
2) Ramp to 10% (2h observe at 1% then ramp):
   - rctl rollout softflip adjust --tenants t-aaa,t-bbb --fraction 0.10
   - Confirm synthetic prompt checks ran at least twice and pass thresholds.
3) Expand to all scheduled internal cohorts and sandboxes (target ~0.8% total).
4) Extended observe: 24h with mid-window quality review (calendar invite: Softflip check-in 1).

Immediate rollback commands (if any guardrail breaches):
- Fast pinback: rctl rollout softflip disable --tenants all --model model-v12-q4 --immediate
- Engine-level kill: rctl capacity drain --pool v12-canary --grace 30s (for severe latency cascade)
- Emergency toggle from console: revert routing to route-by-tenant with hard pin to model-v11-opt

Telemetry playbook (who watches what):
- Primary watcher (eng): Lena (live dash), Evan (logs/trace follow-up).
- Secondary (SRE on-call): Priya (pager).
- CS liaisons: pinged via slack thread #softflip-rollout.
- Diagnostics to collect on anomalies: full request traces (trace-id list), token distribution histograms, per-model memory/GPU pressure metrics, kv-cache hit ratio.

Observability probes and synthetic tests to run continuously:
- Every 15m: run 200 canonical prompts against both model-v11-opt and model-v12-q4, record similarity and latency.
- Every 30m: run hallucination heuristics on 100 sampled responses (eval job id).
- Continuous: headroom monitor that triggers slack alert if mean GPU util > 78% for 10m.

Open questions / known unknowns:
- How does v12 tokenization change effective token count for common prompts? (May affect cost and throttling.)
- Is there any downstream schema change in structured output that could trip existing client parsing? Need a quick parser-check across SDK versions.
- Fallback behavior: when kv-cache miss spikes, do we auto-fall back to v11 for the request or fail closed? Current policy: failover only on 5xx; consider expanding to performance-triggered fallback.

Post-observe decision rubric (after 24h):
- Promote candidate if: telemetry within thresholds, no customer complaints, synthetic checks pass, no backlog or surge in latency in other regions due to routing.
- Extend experiment if partial regressions that look tunable (e.g., slight latency bump but lower cost) — require additional 48h and capacity increase to reduce cold starts.
- Pinback and postmortem if: any business signal incident OR consecutive windows (3x 1h) with p95 > threshold.

Quick notes (handy commands):
- List active softflip tenants: rctl rollout softflip list --region us-west1
- Fetch recent traces for tenant t-aaa: logsql "select * from traces where tenant='t-aaa' and ts > now()-1h" --out traces.json
- Run local eval against given sample set: ./scripts/run_local_eval.sh --model model-v12-q4 --samples samples/softflip/2024-09-25.json

Checklist before sign-off (owner: Arjun):
- [ ] CS pre-notice sent (done?) -> Lena to confirm
- [ ] Dash boards created and shared with watchers
- [ ] SDK feature flag deployed to checkout stage
- [ ] PR #842 merged and canary build available
- [ ] Emergency rollback playbook published to Confluence (link above)

Notes from earlier dry-run (2024-09-21):
- Observed a 12% p95 increase on one synthetic set correlated with tokenization boundary. Fix was adjusting batching window from 20ms to 30ms; we should test that parameter before ramp.
- Minor serialization mismatch in structured outputs flagged by integration tests; patch in PR#847 pending. Need to block full promotion until merged.

Postmortem hooks (if we roll back):
- Timeboxed 96h timeline for root-cause investigation and a prioritized mitigation list.
- Required artifacts for RCA: traces, sample payloads, traffic split config, model artifact checksums (sha256).

Random personal TODOs (scratch):
- Draft short CS nudge template for tenants (2 lines: what we changed, how to opt-out, who to contact).
- Add a synthetic set that hits long-context edge cases (1000-token prompts).
- Confirm with infra that v12 can be removed from pool without rebalancing other pools.

End of notes.

(This is a working scratchpad — if something here needs to be promoted to the canonical playbook, move to Confluence and link back.)
